en: Monochrome historic postcard showing a tree‑lined street leading to an arched gate complex attached to large, multi‑storey buildings with tiled roofs and ornate towers. The central building has two rows of arched windows above three large passageway arches. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks. The caption at the top reads "Graz. Burgtor, Erzherzog Johann-Allee."
